newsitem.title: USA: Gap Oct same-store sales rise four pct.
newsitem.headline: Gap Oct same-store sales rise four pct.

text.p: Gap Inc on Thursday said sales for the four-week period ended Nov. 2 rose 19 percent to $413 million from $347 million for the comparable period ended Nov. 4, 1995. Same-store sales rose four percent.
Sales of $3.62 billion for the 39 weeks ended Nov. 2 were up 24 percent over sales of $2.92 billion for the same period in 1995. Year to date same store sales increased six percent.
As of November 2, Gap operated 1,823 stores compared to 1,643 at Oct. 28, 1995, an increase of 11 percent.
